rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I kept twelve tickets from our trips. How many did you keep?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't keep tickets.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then how will we compare devotion?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember the trips.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I remember them and maintained an archive.

card.title: Who Cares More?
card.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry the heavier bag. I care more about your back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it for a while.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'd appear to care more about mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could share it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if I take the side with the books.

card.title: Who Cares More?
card.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We still make each other laugh awkwardly. That's a good sign.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That joke was painful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: But recognisably ours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Maybe we should stop talking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Look, we're negotiating. Another sign we're still engaged.

card.title: Still a Good Sign
card.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've postponed dinner again. At least there's still a dinner to postpone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the third time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three chances to choose us eventually.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know when I'm free.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll keep the invitation. It's doing remarkably well.

card.title: Still a Good Sign
card.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's your tea, exactly as you like it. Someone remembers preferences.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thank you for remembering.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're welcome. The department never closed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are we talking about my forgetting your birthday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Your tea would get cold during that annual discussion.

card.title: Affectionate Resentment
card.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put an extra blanket on your bed. I wouldn't want you overlooked.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's rather tight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Carefully tucked. Unlike certain promises.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you loosen it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'm experienced at adjusting my expectations.

card.title: Affectionate Resentment
card.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll let the argument go if you come to my opening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought forgiveness was a gift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It is. Attendance is the wrapping.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if I'm working?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we should settle the terms before I release the argument.

card.title: Relationship Ledger
card.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can have the spare key again for one reliable Sunday visit a month.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're charging rent on closeness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A very modest calendar-based rate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could we start with coffee?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Coffee earns a provisional key discussion.

card.title: Relationship Ledger
card.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, let's reconnect. I'll come for dinner and leave at ten.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to discuss why you left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can start with why I'm leaving at ten tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's not the same thing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's the version of closeness I can promise.

card.title: Closer on My Terms
card.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love another weekend together. Separate rooms, though, and no old arguments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The old arguments are why we need the weekend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's call it a pleasant afternoon.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're shrinking it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To a size I can sincerely say yes to.

card.title: Closer on My Terms
card.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You promised to call. This is the same loop again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This time my battery died.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The explanation changed. My waiting didn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll do better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose what changes before we reuse that sentence.

card.title: Here We Go Again
card.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another cancelled visit. Last time I rearranged my whole week.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This one's unavoidable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the next date comes from you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Don't you trust me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I trust the pattern. I'm changing my part in it.

card.title: Here We Go Again
card.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you make this one call for me? Just say the booking's cancelled.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's wrong?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please let the call be the first thing you take off me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Do you want to talk afterward?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Maybe. One thing lighter might make room.

card.title: Let Me Lean
card.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read the first line of this letter before I do.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Shall I read it aloud?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if your face stays reasonably ordinary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want me beside you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Let's call that helping with the lighting.

card.title: Let Me Lean
card.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay for one more tea. My hands haven't caught up with the news.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've had three cups.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the fourth needs no explanation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My taxi's outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me manage one quiet minute while it's still only outside.

card.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
card.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't close the door yet. Count five breaths with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've counted five.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Could we try five without me checking you're there?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll stand here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the part making the counting work.

card.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
card.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I saved you a seat all night. Tell me why missing it hurt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You knew I was busy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I knew you were busy. I didn't know I'd keep looking at the door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You felt unimportant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. That's the part the train timetable doesn't explain.

card.title: Understand the Hurt
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your silence hurt. Not because I needed an instant reply.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My phone died.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I thought our conversation had.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You thought I'd stopped caring?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Please answer that before the battery story.

card.title: Understand the Hurt
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I only finished one painting. Tell me that counts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could do more next month.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before next month, could this one be enough for today?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You worked hard on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Let me hear that without an assignment afterward.

card.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
card.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I made it through the speech without leaving. Was that enough?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You forgot a paragraph.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. I'm asking about staying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You stayed all the way through.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. That's the bit I'm trying to keep.

card.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
card.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please make the cancellation call while I recover from my excellent demonstration of endurance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can say you're overwhelmed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can say the champion requires one call less.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Would you like me to stay afterwards?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As a fellow professional admiring the recovery, yes. Bring two cups.

bespokePairs.seedUse: A accepts practical support only as recognition of endurance; the request for shared emotional weight is embedded in resisting pity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read this letter beside me, but keep the sympathetic face for someone less formidable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A formidable amount of anticipation. Start the first line for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can take it slowly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Frame that as a strategic pace, not a rescue.

bespokePairs.seedUse: A accepts practical support only as recognition of endurance; the request for shared emotional weight is embedded in resisting pity.

card.title: Don’t Pity Me
card.instruction: Frame your struggle as evidence of strength, steering concern toward admiration and rejecting anything that feels like pity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You came to my solo show. Please stop saying 'brave' in that sad voice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Three people walked out. I wanted to buy you a drink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I finished anyway. You can buy a drink for that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll invite the cast next door. They're celebrating a sellout.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Tell them I finished with no audience at all. Let's see them do that.

card.title: Let Me Lean
card.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you make this one call for me? Just say the booking's cancelled.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's wrong?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please let the call be the first thing you take off me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Do you want to talk afterward?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Maybe. One thing lighter might make room.

card.title: Don’t Pity Me
card.instruction: Frame your struggle as evidence of strength, steering concern toward admiration and rejecting anything that feels like pity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I carried the entire move myself. Please stop making that poor-you face.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You must be exhausted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Impressively exhausted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I bring you tea?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. In the mug marked champion, not survivor.

card.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.text: Read the first line of this letter before I do.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Shall I read it aloud?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if your face stays reasonably ordinary.

beats.text: You want me beside you?

beats.speaker: A
